macros.name: psbarlabel
macros.doc: By default, \psbarlabel sets the column label in the current text font.

macros.name: psbarlabelsep
macros.doc: To adjust the spacing between the bars and the column labels, redefine \psbarlabelsep .

macros.name: psbarscale
macros.doc: The data are scaled by the value in parentheses and may be further manipulated with Postscript code.
